system.name: PruneX
system.one_liner: A data-driven logic synthesis heuristic paradigm that learns a generalizable classifier to skip ineffective node-level transformations, with a circuit domain generalization framework.

content.variant_note: a classic top-down flowchart whose node-set extraction step is expanded sideways into the default version (green) and the PruneX version (orange)
content.argues: Traditional logic synthesis heuristics transform every node of the circuit; PruneX replaces the full node set with an effective node set chosen by a learned pruning model, leaving the loop unchanged.
content.subject: A flowchart of a node-level logic synthesis heuristic whose node-set extraction step is expanded into the default version and the PruneX version.

lessons.what_to_learn: To contrast a baseline with a proposed variant of one step in a standard algorithm, draw the whole flowchart once and expand only the changed step sideways into two colour-coded brackets (green default, orange ours) joined by dashed leaders, so everything else stays shared.
lessons.suits: Methods that replace or insert one component in an established algorithm or heuristic: pruning, learned filters, learned selectors, learned cost models.

evidence: We illustrate a unified paradigm of these LS heuristics as shown in Figure 1.
PruneX uses the learned classifier to predict ineffective nodes to accelerate the X heuristic in the online phase.

summary: PruneX is a data-driven paradigm for logic synthesis heuristics such as Resub and Mfs2, which apply a transformation to the subgraph at every node of a circuit DAG although many are ineffective. It trains a classifier, helped by a circuit domain generalization framework, to predict and skip ineffective nodes on unseen circuits. Figure 1 draws the unified paradigm as a top-down flowchart: Start, Input: Original Circuit, Extract Node Id Set N, an Optimization For Loop with the decisions i=|N|? and Gain>0?, Update Circuit, Out: Optimized Circuit, End. Dashed leaders expand the extraction step into a green Default Heuristic (Get All Nodes, Full Node Id Set N) and an orange Our PruneX Heuristic (Node Features Extraction, Node Pruning Model, Effective Node Id Set N).
summary_zh: PruneX是面向逻辑综合启发式的数据驱动范式，学习分类器跳过无效节点变换。图1是自上而下的流程图，“提取节点集N”一步用虚线展开为绿色默认版（取全部节点）和橙色PruneX版（特征、剪枝模型、有效节点集），循环共用。
